findings.title: Refusal error is never asserted, only inferred indirectly
findings.claim: The catch (const rpc::closed_error&) swallows the error without recording it; the test relies only on the indirect put_after_close flag, which depends on the batch-flush poller running within 10 yield()s, so a regression could pass if the poller runs late.

findings.title: Assertion/exception failure inside parked window aborts process instead of failing test
findings.claim: If BOOST_REQUIRE_EQUAL(hooks.size(), 2u) fails, or the hook throws anything other than closed_error, release_close is never set and sink_closed is never awaited, causing ~sink_impl to hit SEASTAR_ASSERT(sink_closed()) and abort instead of failing the test cleanly.

findings.title: Doc claim that reading until throw closes the source is wrong
findings.claim: The doc (and the source doc in include/seastar/rpc/rpc_types.hh:384-389) says reading until it throws closes the stream, but only failures from stream_receive() call close_source(); an exception from unmarshall() in process_one_buffer reaches the caller without closing the source, so a reader that stops at that throw leaves the stream half open.

findings.title: Doc statement that connection shuts down only when both halves close contradicts itself
findings.claim: "The stream's connection is shut down only once both halves are closed" is contradicted elsewhere in the same doc: connection errors and abort_all_streams() also shut it down, and line 49 says closing the client aborts streams; wording should be changed to something like "normally shuts down once".

findings.title: Test hooks recorded via const_cast instead of a mutable member
findings.claim: Test negotiate() records hooks through a const_cast; making hooks a mutable member would be cleaner.

findings.title: PR description ends with a Claude Code attribution line
findings.claim: The PR description ends with "🤖 Generated with Claude Code", which the user's global instructions forbid.

findings.title: Fixes/Refs issue references resolve to the wrong repo
findings.claim: In the fork dkropachev/ironweave, "Fixes #3663" and "Refs #3653" resolve to, and on merge auto-close, this repo's issues rather than upstream Seastar's; use scylladb/seastar#3663 if upstream is meant.
